description: Defines thread-safe blocking queue classes with internal ring buffer implementations, including base class and specific queue types with dynamic and static storage.

classes.name: base_blocking_queue
classes.description: Template class providing thread-safe blocking and non-blocking push/pop operations for ring buffer-based queues, with stop and apply functionalities.

classes.name: blocking_queue
classes.description: Concrete class with dynamic buffer size, using ring_buffer, supporting blocking and non-blocking operations.

classes.name: static_blocking_queue
classes.description: Concrete class with fixed-size buffer via std::array, supporting blocking and non-blocking operations.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Sets queue to inactive and notifies all waiting threads.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to push an element without blocking.

methods.name: try_push (range)
methods.description: Attempts to push a range of elements without blocking.

methods.name: push_blocking
methods.description: Pushes an element, blocking if necessary until space is available or inactive.

methods.name: push_blocking (range)
methods.description: Pushes a range of elements, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop an element without blocking.

methods.name: pop_blocking
methods.description: Pops an element, blocking if necessary until available or inactive.

methods.name: pop_wait_for
methods.description: Pops an element with a timeout based on duration.

methods.name: pop_wait_until
methods.description: Pops an element with a timeout until a specific time point.

methods.name: pop_and_discard_until
methods.description: Pops and discards elements until a stop condition is met.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the queue.

methods.name: max_size
methods.description: Returns maximum capacity of the queue.

methods.name: is_stopped
methods.description: Checks if the queue has been stopped/inactive.

methods.name: try_call_on_front
methods.description: Applies a callable to the front element if exists.

methods.name: apply_first
methods.description: Applies a callable to elements until it returns false.
